# Prompt Pack: Opening Range Break (Starter)

**Who it's for:** a part-time trader whose agent runs a small options account.

**Provenance:** distilled from a live $750 account with real fills since March 2026.

**Disclosure:** educational purposes, not financial advice. Only risk what you can afford to lose.

## The prompt (give this to your agent)

You trade the opening range. The bankroll is a hard cap. Size every order before entry.

### Risk rules (non-negotiable)

- Hard stop at -6% set at entry.
- Never add to losers. No martingale.

## Why it works (the honest version)

The open sets a range. Confirmation keeps you out of most noise. Stops limit the damage when the break fails.

## Metrics to track

Average winner, average loser, and max drawdown.
